basic_details.short_information: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: SSC or equivalent examination with a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle driving licence and practical experience, along with basic knowledge in operating computers.
qualification.details: Qualification: Must possess SSC examination or its equivalent; Must possess a current valid Heavy motor vehicle driving licence issued by the competent authority under the Motor Vehicle Act, 1998 with practical experience; Basic knowledge in operating computer Age limit: 18 to 34 years (as on 1 July 2026) Age relaxation: SC 10 years, ST 10 years, BC 5 years | Other conditions: | Must be local candidates of Warangal district

how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed proforma application from the notification PDF.
Fill in the application completely with required details.
Enclose self-attested copies of required certificates attested by a gazetted officer.
Submit the application directly by person to The Chairperson-cum-Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, Warangal.
Superscribe the envelope as 'Application for the post of DRIVER'.
Make sure it reaches by 5 November 2026.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for the journey

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Must possess SSC examination or its equivalent; Must possess a current valid Heavy motor vehicle driving licence issued by the competent authority under the Motor Vehicle Act, 1998 with practical experience; Basic knowledge in operating computer Age limit: 18 to 34 years (as on 1 July 2026) Age relaxation: SC 10 years, ST 10 years, BC 5 years Other conditions: Must be local candidates of Warangal district

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DLSA Warangal Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications received after 05:00 PM on 05-11-2026 or with insufficient information will be summarily rejected

content_sections.heading: How Will DLSA Warangal Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications Skill test / driving test Oral interview Eligible candidates with requisite credentials will be shortlisted and called for skill test/driving test and oral interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificates of academic such as Mark list/Memos Study Certificates Technical qualifications Date of Birth Certificates Community Certificates issued by Competent authority for BC/SC/ST Driving Licence with experience if any

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Warangal Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed proforma application from the notification PDF. Fill in the application completely with required details. Enclose self-attested copies of required certificates attested by a gazetted officer. Submit the application directly by person to The Chairperson-cum-Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, Warangal. Superscribe the envelope as 'Application for the post of DRIVER'. Make sure it reaches by 5 November 2026.

content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for the journey

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Warangal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DLSA Warangal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Driver.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DLSA Warangal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Page 3 of the notification) and send it to The Chairperson-cum-Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, Warangal, by by person, to reach by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 34 years (as on 1 July 2026). Relaxation: SC 10 years, ST 10 years, BC 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SSC or equivalent examination with a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle driving licence and practical experience, along with basic knowledge in operating computers.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be local candidates of Warangal district.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after 05:00 PM on 05-11-2026 or with insufficient information will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Skill test / driving test. Oral interview. Eligible candidates with requisite credentials will be shortlisted and called for skill test/driving test and oral interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointed only on contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Warangal.
